articles.title: Maharashtra Pushes To Open Latur & Baramati Airports For All-Weather Flight Operations
articles.description: Maharashtra Airport Development Company plans to upgrade Latur and Baramati airstrips with investments of ₹56 crore and ₹64 crore respectively. The projects aim to enable night and all-weather operations under instrument flight rules, while assessing capacity for 70-to-80-seat turboprop aircraft. MADC has invited consultants to prepare plans, secure approvals and oversee construction.
